decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 10th June 2004, the matter described above is lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:

The chauffeur business involves the use of a small room in the existing dwellinghouse as an office area as well as the rear garage to store the two business vehicles.  It required no internal or external alterations to the property, no external signage has been erected and it attracts no business related clients on site.  The scale and nature of the business use is therefore considered ancillary to the residential use, with the property continuing as a dwellinghouse and, as it does not result in a material change of use to part or whole of the dwelling, planning permission is not required.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the existing use of one room as office.
